current_evidence: The List 1 and List 2 introduction pages both state 'adopted this local list on 7 December 2017' (pages last modified 4 May 2023). Two searches found no newer, draft or consultation list for Welwyn Hatfield.

issues.detail: The Validation list URL is item page 13 of List 1, which covers only 3b Air Quality, 3c Archaeological Assessment and 3d Bin Stores. It is not the local list itself. The local list is a multi-page web checklist: the List 1 introduction (full, outline, LBC-with-planning and advert-with-planning applications, items 2-36), List 2 (householder), plus further lists (List 4, List 5 and national requirements pages). The workbook should link the List 1 introduction or the set of list introductions.
issues.evidence: Page 13 title 'Validation Checklist - List 1', sections 3b/3c/3d only; List 1 intro lists sections 2-36

issues.detail: The List date is blank and Outdated (>2y) says 'Undated', but the list introduction pages state an adoption date of 7 December 2017. The list is over 2 years old, so the Outdated flag should be Yes. The list still cites the District Plan 2005 and the Draft Local Plan Proposed Submission August 2016.
issues.evidence: List 1 and List 2 intro: 'adopted this local list on 7 December 2017'

issues.detail: The workbook captured only about 12 of the 35 List 1 items. Not captured: 3b Air Quality Assessment, which is on the very page linked (housing within or adjoining an AQMA; proposals needing an ES or Transport Assessment; schemes that increase congestion or change traffic composition; more than 300 new car parking spaces or coach/lorry parks; sensitive areas). Also missing: 3k Daylight and Sunlight Assessment for full/outline (major applications with a potential adverse impact on daylight/sunlight of adjoining properties); 14 Biodiversity Survey/Report; 11/15 Parking Plan and Car Parking; 16 Chalk Mining; 17 Character Analysis and Contaminated Land; 22 Heritage Statement for planning applications; 25 Marketing Assessment; 26 Noise and vibration assessment; 27 Open Space Assessment; 28 Planning Obligations and Statement; 29 Retail Assessment; 30 Site Waste Management Plan; 31 Statement of Community Involvement and Justification; 33 Foul Sewage Assessment; 34 Transport Statements, Transport Assessments and Green Travel Plans; 35 Ventilation/Extraction Equipment; 36 Water Usage; 8 Plant and Flue Drawings; 9 Shop Fronts or ATMs; 10 Basements or Excavations.
issues.evidence: List 1 'In this section' menu items 2-36; page 13 '3b Air Quality Assessment ... more than 300 new car parking spaces'

issues.detail: The only Householder row is 'Pre-application advice'. List 2 (Householder, and Householder plus LBC) sets local requirements for Parking Plan, Biodiversity Survey/Report, Flood Risk Assessment, Heritage Statement Appraisal and/or Heritage Impact Statement, Schedule of works and Statement of Justification, and existing/proposed floor plans, elevations, sections and floor levels. None of these appear under Householder.
issues.evidence: List 2 menu: '4 Parking Plan, 5 Biodiversity Survey/Report, 6 Flood Risk Assessment (FRA), 7 Heritage Statement..., 8 Schedule of works and Statement of Justification'

issues.detail: The Daylight / Sunlight / Overshadowing Assessment row has the cycle parking trigger ('3j Cycle Parking Required for all new build and change of use'). The actual 3k trigger is major applications with a potential adverse impact on the daylight/sunlight enjoyed by adjoining properties, including gardens and amenity space.
issues.evidence: Page 18: '3k Daylight and Sunlight Assessment Required for major applications where there is a potential adverse impact upon the current levels of sunlight/daylight ... enjoyed by adjoining properties'

issues.detail: 'Block plan / Site plan' is placed under Discharge of conditions and Non-material amendment. Those are exactly the application types the source exempts.
issues.evidence: 'Site Plan/Block Plan Required for all applications, except non material amendments and submission of details'

issues.detail: Cycle parking and Daylight assessment sit under 'Change of use - prior approval', but List 1 applies to applications for planning permission (full, outline, LBC-with-planning, advert-with-planning), not prior approvals. Separately, many List 1 items carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' notes (Archaeology, Drainage, EIA, FRA, Floor plans, Landscape strategy, Bin stores). List 1 states it applies equally to outline applications, yet the Outline rows hold only Visual Impact Assessment and pre-app advice.
issues.evidence: List 1 intro: covers 'Application for Planning Permission; Application for Outline Planning Permission with Some/All Matters Reserved; ... Planning Permission and Consent to Display Advertisement(s)'

issues.detail: The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' rows under Householder, Outline and Listed building consent are introductory process text from the list intros, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: 'In instances where pre-application advice has been sought, the case officer will advise you of necessary information.'

issues.detail: Some rows use text from a different item or a fragment as the trigger. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' cites a sentence from the FRA page about the FRA forming part of an ES. That is not an EIA requirement in the local list. 'Floor plans / Elevations' cites 'The plan should include elevations with dimensions', which is the bin store plan detail from 3d. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' gives only the fragment 'required and/or sustainable drainage systems.' with no trigger. The Affordable Housing trigger is garbled ('a site of a site of 0.5 hectares').
issues.evidence: Page 13 '3d Bin Stores ... dimensioned elevations'; page 21 FRA text
issues.grok_comment: The EIA, floor-plan and SuDS points are valid. However, "a site of a site of 0.5 hectares" is verbatim in the council's Affordable Housing page (raw 85f43962d3), so it is source text, not garbling by Grokbot.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. "A site of a site of" is the council's own typo. The EIA, floor plan and SuDS points stand.

summary: The linked page is a single item page (List 1 #13) of Welwyn Hatfield's web-based local list, which is still the current list (adopted 7 December 2017), but the workbook records no date. Coverage is thin: most List 1 items (including Air Quality on the linked page itself) and all List 2 householder requirements are missing, and there are several mis-assigned triggers and application types.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
